denon-dn-500av.json.notes: Telnet 23 or RS-232 9600 8N1. Same AVR ASCII as consumer Denon. Source names follow the unit labels (HDMI is assigned to BD/SAT/CBL/etc in the 500AV menu). Volume 00–98.

extron-ipl-t-sfi244.json.notes: SIS on TCP 23. Factory IP 192.168.254.254. Leave the unit password empty for first tests. COM1/COM2 raw passthrough is TCP 2001/2002 — point the attached device’s own driver at those ports. IR play needs .eir files loaded with IR Learner / Global Configurator (file + function numbers).

extron-mps-602.json.notes: No Ethernet on the switcher. SIS is RS-232 9600 8N1 on the rear captive-screw port (or USB Config). Behind an IPL, bind this device to the IPL COM slot (TCP 2001/2002). Simple commands (! V Z B M) are literal. Tagged commands: manual E is ESC (0x1B), } is CR. Inputs: 1-2 VGA, 3-5 HDMI, 6 DTP. Program volume 0-100. 1Z mutes program. Mic gain 0-60 dB (16*{n}G); 1M/0M mute mic. Signal presence: ESC 0LS CR, reply Sig in1..in6 * rgb hdmi.

extron-xpa-1002.json.notes: No LAN. Bind Interface to an IPL/IPCP Flex I/O slot (TCP 23), not COM/IR. Standby = digital out (contact to XPA standby/GND). Volume = analog voltage on pin C (0–10 V); IPL T SFI244 has analog input only — volume.set fails until the gateway profile defines analogOut. Set standbyLine / volumeLine to 1–4.

google-chromecast.json.notes: Cast on TCP 8009. Play/Pause read the live mediaSessionId from the dongle. Volume uses valueMap 0–100 → 0–1.

home-assistant.json.notes: Local REST on TCP 8123. Create a long-lived access token (HA Profile → Security) and paste it in the token field. Set entity to one entity_id (sensor.office_pir) to poll that state into a monitor. Inventory lists all entities. homeassistant.turn_on/off works for lights, switches, scenes, covers.

ipmidi.json.notes: Raw MIDI bytes over UDP multicast 225.0.0.37:21928 TTL 1 (ipMIDI-style). Host on the card is unused unless lan.multicast is false. Status nibbles are channel 1 (90 / 80 / B0). Not MIDI-TCP and not Apple RTP-MIDI.

lg-oled55c3.json.notes: IP control demo driver. Simulated by default.

mitsubishi-ud8900u.json.notes: PJLink Class 1 on TCP 4352. Default password admin if PJLINK 1. Inputs: Computer 1/2, Video, S-Video, HDMI, DVI, SDI. UD8850U is the same minus SDI.

osc-udp.json.notes: OSC over UDP. Host is the receiver. Port default 9000. Command payload is the OSC path. Optional osc.types (s/i/f/b) and osc.values with {value}/{auth.*}.

philips-hue-bridge.json.notes: Press the button on the bridge, then Probe. Save the username token. group 0 = all lights.

pi-gpio.json.notes: Line number in Port. Chip gpiochip0.

pjlink-projector.json.notes: TCP 4352. Password in auth.password if PJLINK 1.

relay-host.json.notes: localhost = this process. Other room: LAN IP + that room’s listen port + that room’s peer secret in Secret (not Token). Restart / update / reboot only from this configurator.

rtp-midi.json.notes: AppleMIDI session on the card IP, control port 5004, data port 5005. Enable Network MIDI on the desk and type the IPv4 — no Bonjour. Hex MIDI, channel-1 status nibbles. Not MIDI-TCP and not ipMIDI multicast. Session dies if the desk sleeps.

sacn-universe.json.notes: E1.31 multicast 239.255.0.{universe}:5568 TTL 1. Set universe on the card (1–63999). Slot 1 is the first DMX address. Do not run sACN on office Wi-Fi.

samsung-qe50q65t.json.notes: Tizen remote: keys and Allow are wss://TV:8002. HTTP :8001/api/v2/ is status only. Authenticate on 8002, save token. Power On needs MAC + WOL. Sync inventory for installed apps; bind App launch. If that fails, try App native.

samsung-qe77s95d.json.notes: 2024 S95D: Authenticate on wss 8002 only (8001 will not show Allow). Enable Power On with Mobile / IP Remote. Use the wired MAC if on Ethernet. WOL waits 10s. Sync inventory for apps.

samsung-tizen.json.notes: Generic Tizen IP remote. Keys and Allow are wss://TV:8002 (samsung.remote.control). HTTP :8001/api/v2/ is status only. Authenticate on 8002, Accept Allow, save the token, keep port 8002. This driver then tries 8001 for older sets that still pair there; 2024+ (S95D class) often ignore 8001. Enable Power On with Mobile / IP Remote. Cold power-on needs WOL + MAC (wired MAC if on Ethernet). Sync inventory for apps; bind App launch, or App native if that fails. KEY_NETFLIX is the hardware key only.

sonos-s1-s2.json.notes: Put the player's LAN IPv4 in the device card (not a hostname). Port 1400. For a grouped room, use the group coordinator's IP; Play/Pause/Next sent to a member are ignored or 500. Play needs something in the queue (error 701 if idle). SOAP on this LAN, no login.

sonos-zoneplayer.json.notes: Local UPnP on TCP 1400. No cloud, no pairing. Point the device IP at the group coordinator (the speaker that shows the group name). Volume 0–100.

sony-vpl-fhz120l.json.notes: ADCP TCP 53595. Enable ADCP in the web UI. Requires Authentication OFF (banner NOKEY). Only one TCP client — close the projector web Control page. Commands use CR+LF. Warm-up can take a minute after power on. PJLink 4352 is a separate driver.

usb-midi.json.notes: ALSA amidi on Linux only. Add a MIDI interface and set Path to hw:1,0,0 (amidi -l). Status nibbles are channel 1 (90 / 80 / B0). {midiChannel} is decimal 1–16 for ASCII; do not stuff it into hex. No Windows / WinMM.

wake-on-lan.json.notes: Wake uses the NIC MAC (enable WOL in BIOS). Shutdown: Windows RPC (user/password; Linux host needs samba-common-bin) or HTTP GET to auth.path on this device’s Port (small helper on the PC).

zowietek-zowiebox.json.notes: HTTP :80 ZowieAPI (Companion POST bodies). Encoder XOR decoder. Local RTSP is always on: rtsp://IP:8554/main/av and /sub/av. NDI encode on often drops internet RTMP/SRT. Stream 0–3 are existing Internet publish slots. Record tasks: usb1_0, sdcard_0, nas1_0. Output format commands also set HDMI audio on and loop-out on (API requires all three). PTZ talks to a camera attached to the box (Visca). NDI decode needs the source name in the ndi field. Digital zoom 100–1200. No session cookie. Not a USB capture card. Encode bitrate/profile omitted — that POST replaces the whole venc array.
